parsed.explanation: Combined regime is High-to-Elevated risk, sitting near the 0.35 line. National layer drives it: passport sex-marker restrictions in force (Nov 2025), entry-screening cable refusing discrepant cases with a possible lifetime fraud finding, and documented abuse in immigration custody (forced labour, beatings, sexual abuse) and corrections care denial. State layer is comparatively moderate: no statewide adult restroom or adult-care ban, document changes still available, marriage recognised, sodomy repealed. Offsetting factors are limited: no statewide gender-identity nondiscrimination or hate-crime coverage, protection only in four municipalities, and no operative recourse shown for visitors. Minors face youth-care restrictions and a federal subpoena of hospital records. Rating rests on documented custody and entry harms.

entry_documents.exposure: Passports marked by birth sex; new applications processed only as M or F. Entry cable refuses cases with document discrepancy or doubt about sex and requests more evidence. Possible permanent fraud-ground ineligibility for alleged misrepresentation. Passports confiscated or blocked, with some travellers stranded.
entry_documents.protection: Existing X passports valid to expiry. Fraud ground requires four elements and is not automatic. Civil-liberties suit pending, with policy challenged but in force per Nov 2025 Supreme Court order.
entry_documents.interaction: Document mismatch at entry leads to refusal or evidence demand, which can escalate to a lifetime ineligibility finding or detention. Universal exposure for any visitor whose presentation differs from passport.

investigation_detention_custody.exposure: Immigration custody documented for forced labour, beatings, solitary confinement and severe sexual abuse of transgender men. Refusal to comply was punished. Corrections bureau adopted conversion-style policies from 2026 and stopped reporting trans prisoner counts.
investigation_detention_custody.protection: Not documented for visitors. Consular access exists in principle; no evidence it changes outcomes.
investigation_detention_custody.interaction: Entry refusal or fraud allegation can route a visitor into immigration custody, where documented abuse and birth-sex or care-denial harms follow. Federal custody sits above state law.

federal_state_facilities.exposure: Federal facilities restricted by national executive order. State facility bans are mostly government-owned or schools. This state has no statewide adult restroom or changing-room ban. District policy binds one school district only. Trespass-based criminal exposure is documented in other states, not shown for this one.
federal_state_facilities.protection: No statewide adult facility ban. No statewide criminal bathroom statute documented for this state. Municipal ordinances cover some public accommodations.
federal_state_facilities.interaction: National funding and facility orders apply to federal buildings regardless of this state's permissive adult rule. Local-only protection does not offset federal exposure.

care_services.exposure: Adult care not banned statewide. Draft state regulation would make under-18 transition care unprofessional conduct, not yet operative. Federal proposed rule would bar public insurance for under-18 care. National subpoena of hospital records for patients under 19. Youth care banned in 27 states.
care_services.protection: No statewide ban on adult gender-affirming care. Medical-board action is a recommendation and draft, not operative.
care_services.interaction: A visitor seeking adult care faces little state restriction. A minor or family seeking care faces record-disclosure and provider-discipline risk, and federal rules may reach care delivered out of state.

threat_framing_law_enforcement.exposure: National counterterrorism strategy names 'radically pro-transgender' groups as targets for neutralisation. Cash reward system references 'radical gender ideology'. Directive to prosecute teachers facilitating social transition. Official threat-framing at national level.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.protection: Strategy states powers will not target people who simply disagree. Several orders blocked or enjoined.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.interaction: Threat-framing bears on any visitor identified as trans-advocacy-linked. Increases the severity of any police or security contact, not just visitor identity.

minors_guardians.exposure: Youth care banned in 27 states. National rules and subpoenas target under-19 records. Teacher prosecution directive. One school district bars transgender students from matching bathrooms. Travelling minor faces entry and record-disclosure risk, plus custody consequences if separated from guardian.
minors_guardians.protection: No documented statewide ban on minors travelling or visiting. Student bathroom rule limited to one district.
minors_guardians.interaction: A minor's documents and any care records can surface at entry or in medical settings, and the guardian can become a subject of investigation.

street_violence_police_response.exposure: Trespass arrest documented in another state with 24-hour holding. Hate-crime statute excludes gender identity at state level. No state record of trans-specific violence or homicide rate given, so violence axis not assessed.
street_violence_police_response.protection: National hate-crime statute covers gender identity. Four municipalities cover gender identity in public accommodations. Guidance on bias-crime investigation not in inventory.
street_violence_police_response.interaction: Recourse for visitors is municipal only. Outside those four places a visitor has no state recourse for discrimination or bias-driven violence.

remedies_unknowns.exposure: Discrimination in hotels, restaurants and workplaces unremedied outside four municipalities. Enforcement of local ordinances not sourced. National orders litigated, so rules in force at travel time unclear.
remedies_unknowns.protection: Document changes available in state. Marriage recognised. Sodomy law repealed (1980). Municipal ordinances in four places cover 46% of population.
remedies_unknowns.interaction: Federal instability and pending litigation mean exposure may change within the trip. State recourse is thin, so entry and custody harms carry the rating.

anchor_checks.comparison: Both feature routine document-based refusal and exclusion of trans visitors with weak appeal. This case adds documented immigration custody abuse including sexual abuse and forced labour, which is more severe. It lacks Vellandra's universal visitor-register exclusion and criminal-charge pathway, so it sits similar to or slightly above.

Both show custody harm: birth-sex placement and documented assault. This case has no statewide adult criminal cross-dressing statute and no state-level facility arrest pattern, and it has more operative state protections. It sits moderately above that anchor.

Both involve national document-linked exposure that reaches every visitor. This case has entry refusal and detention risk and documented custody abuse, which 0.45-D lacks. It has no comparable state registry or nightly database linkage, so it sits below 0.45-D.
Both involve secondary-screening and refused admission for mismatched papers. This case adds documented custody abuse and a lifetime fraud-ground risk, so it sits materially below 0.55-B.

parsed.synthesis: The national layer applies to every visitor: birth-sex passport markers, an entry cable that refuses discrepant cases, and a possible lifetime fraud ban. When that discrepancy escalates, the documented immigration-custody record (forced labour, beatings, sexual abuse) is the operative outcome. The state layer is comparatively moderate. No statewide adult facility or care ban, marriage recognition and sodomy repeal offer some mitigation. Gender identity is absent from statewide anti-discrimination and hate-crime law, and only four municipalities provide recourse. Minors face the heaviest combined exposure through care-record subpoenas and state and federal youth-care rules. Overall the combined regime sits in the lower Elevated band near 0.35–0.40.
